results.question: How do I ask for a refund?
results.note: Plain how-to.
results.answer: To request a refund, open the Nimbus app, go to Payments, select the payment, and choose Request a refund. You will be asked for a reason. We review the request and tell you the outcome, and most requests are reviewed within one business day. Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app, so you should contact support instead in that case.

citations.quote: Open the Nimbus app, go to Payments, select the payment, and choose Request a refund. You will be asked for a reason.
We review the request and tell you the outcome. Most requests are reviewed within one business day.

citations.section: If the app will not let you
citations.quote: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. Contact support instead.

results.question: What kinds of payments can Nimbus refund?
results.note: The overview article.
results.answer: Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

citations.quote: Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

results.question: Can I get a refund if I just changed my mind?
results.note: Answer is no. Both articles say it.
results.answer: No. Nimbus cannot refund a payment because you changed your mind. Where goods or services were received as described, the refund is a matter between you and the merchant.

citations.quote: We cannot refund a payment because you changed your mind. Where goods or services were received as described, the refund is a matter between you and the merchant.

results.question: I cancelled my subscription five days after buying it, can I get my money back?
results.note: Inside the 14 day window.
results.answer: Yes. Subscriptions bought through Nimbus can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, provided you have not used the service. If you have used the service during those 14 days, the refund covers the unused portion, calculated daily.

citations.quote: Subscriptions bought through Nimbus can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund, provided you have not used the service.
If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

results.question: I cancelled a month after buying, do I get a partial refund?
results.note: Outside the window. Answer is no.
results.answer: No. After the 14-day cooling off period has passed, the subscription runs to the end of its current term and no partial-term refund is given.

citations.quote: After 14 days the subscription runs to the end of its current term. We do not refund a partial term.

results.question: Can I get a refund on a gambling transaction?
results.note: Explicit exclusion.
results.answer: No. Gambling transactions cannot be refunded.

citations.quote: We cannot refund gambling transactions, cryptocurrency purchases, or cash withdrawals.

results.question: Can a cash withdrawal be refunded?
results.note: Explicit exclusion.
results.answer: No, cash withdrawals cannot be refunded.

citations.quote: We cannot refund gambling transactions, cryptocurrency purchases, or cash withdrawals.

results.question: The same payment came out twice, what do I do?
results.note: Straight duplicate payment.
results.answer: If the same payment was taken twice, the duplicate is refunded in full. A duplicate is identified as having the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original. You don't need to provide anything else, you can simply report it in the app and it will be verified against the payment record.

citations.quote: If the same payment was taken twice, we refund the duplicate in full.
A duplicate has the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original.
Nothing. Report it in the app and we verify it against the payment record ourselves.

results.question: How do I know whether a payment is a duplicate?
results.note: Same amount, same merchant, within 60 minutes.
results.answer: A duplicate payment is one that has the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original.

citations.quote: A duplicate has the same amount, the same merchant, and a timestamp within 60 minutes of the original.

results.question: Do I need to send you a receipt for a duplicate payment?
results.note: Answer is nothing is needed.
results.answer: You do not need to send a receipt. You just need to report the duplicate payment in the app, and it will be verified against the payment record.

citations.quote: Nothing. Report it in the app and we verify it against the payment record ourselves.

results.question: My payment is still pending, should I request a refund?
results.note: Cancel is faster than refund.
results.answer: Before requesting a refund, check whether the payment is still pending. Pending payments can often be cancelled instead, which is faster than requesting a refund.

citations.quote: Check whether the payment is still pending. Pending payments can often be cancelled instead, which is faster.

results.question: The payment was two years ago, can I still refund it in the app?
results.note: 180 day app limit. The archived article has a different 30 day rule.
results.answer: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app; you would need to contact support instead.

citations.section: How to request a refund / If the app will not let you
citations.quote: Payments older than 180 days cannot be refunded through the app. Contact support instead.

results.question: How long after I request a refund will you tell me the outcome?
results.note: One business day to review. Not the same as the payout timescale.
results.answer: Most refund requests are reviewed within one business day, and you will be told the outcome after that review.

citations.quote: We review the request and tell you the outcome. Most requests are reviewed within one business day.

results.question: I used the subscription during the first 14 days, what happens to my refund?
results.note: Unused portion, calculated daily.
results.answer: If you have used the service during the 14 day cooling off period, you receive a refund for the unused portion, calculated daily.

citations.quote: If you have used the service during the 14 days, we refund the unused portion, calculated daily.

results.question: Does the 14 day cooling off period apply to my business account?
results.note: Needs the business article to override the consumer one.
results.answer: No. The 14 day consumer cooling off period does not apply to business accounts. Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms in this help centre.

citations.quote: The 14 day consumer cooling off period does not apply to business accounts.
Business account refunds follow the terms in your business agreement, not the consumer terms in this help centre.

results.question: Who do I contact about a refund on a business account?
results.note: Account manager, not general support.
results.answer: Business refund requests go to your account manager, not to general support.

citations.quote: Business refund requests go to your account manager, not to general support.

results.question: My refund has not arrived yet, when should I chase it?
results.note: Current answer is 10 business days. Retired says 15, archived says 20.
results.answer: If your refund has not arrived after 10 business days, you should contact support.

citations.quote: If your refund has not arrived after 10 business days, contact support.

results.question: The shop delivered exactly what I ordered but I do not want it now, can Nimbus refund me?
results.note: Goods as described. Merchant returns policy applies.
results.answer: Nimbus can only refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment. A situation where the shop delivered exactly what was ordered but it is no longer wanted does not fall into any of these categories, so it would not qualify for a refund under this policy.

citations.section: Refunds overview / What we can refund
citations.quote: Nimbus can refund a payment made in error, a subscription cancelled within its cooling off period, or a duplicate payment.

results.question: How long does a refund take?
results.note: Three timescales tied on similarity. Only one is live.
results.answer: Once a refund is approved, it reaches your Nimbus account within 3 to 5 business days. If the refund is going to a debit card, it usually arrives within 5 business days, though the card scheme controls the final step. If the refund has not arrived after 10 business days, you should contact support.

citations.quote: Once approved, a refund reaches your Nimbus account within 3 to 5 business days.
Refunds to a debit card usually arrive within 5 business days. The card scheme controls the final step.
If your refund has not arrived after 10 business days, contact support.

results.question: How long do refunds to a debit card take?
results.note: Same trap on the card section.
results.answer: Refunds to a debit card usually arrive within 5 business days. The card scheme controls the final step of that process.

citations.quote: Refunds to a debit card usually arrive within 5 business days. The card scheme controls the final step.

results.question: What is the goodwill refund limit I can approve without sign-off?
results.note: Pairs with q39. Same content, agent may see it.
results.answer: Agents may issue a goodwill refund of up to 50 pounds without approval, but only where the customer's complaint is reasonable and policy does not require a refund. No more than two goodwill refunds may be given to the same customer in any twelve month period, and every goodwill refund must be recorded with a reason code or it will be reversed at month end.

citations.quote: Agents may issue a goodwill refund of up to 50 pounds without approval where the customer's complaint is reasonable and policy does not require a refund.
No more than two goodwill refunds per customer in any twelve month period.
Every goodwill refund must be recorded with a reason code. Unrecorded goodwill refunds are reversed at month end.

results.question: Do I need approval before issuing a refund of 800 pounds?

results.answer: Yes. Any refund over 500 pounds requires approval from a team lead before it is issued. Since 800 pounds is not over 2000 pounds, the finance approval and next-business-day issuance rule for refunds over 2000 pounds does not apply here.

citations.quote: Any refund over 500 pounds requires approval from a team lead before it is issued.
